instruction: I want to automatically BCC myself on every email I send. Please enable the automatic BCC feature for my email account so that I receive a copy of all outgoing messages.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling automatic BCC (mail.identity.id1.doBcc=true). Current value is false. Evaluator checks if the preference is set to true. Uses existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric function.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement by checking mail.identity.id1.doBcc preference
Getter appropriately reads Thunderbird prefs.js file after closing the application to ensure settings are flushed to disk
Metric check_thunderbird_prefs correctly parses preferences and performs boolean equality comparison
Postconfig properly closes Thunderbird and adds delay to ensure file system sync
Expected value (mail.identity.id1.doBcc=true) is semantically correct for enabling automatic BCC feature
Complete coverage of instruction - single requirement is fully verified
Data flow is correct: VM file -> getter extracts file -> metric parses and compares boolean value

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
